paper_title: Deep Persona: A Psychologically Grounded Architecture and Evaluation Framework for Role-Playing Agents and Simulations
reason: 이 논문은 Deep Persona라는 역할극 에이전트 구축 아키텍처와 ADOS 임상 척도에서 착안한 참조 없는 대화 자연스러움 평가 프레임워크(DNS, Mahalanobis χ² 검정, 3종 스트레스 테스트)를 제안한다. 그러나 이는 재사용 가능한 벤치마크 데이터셋이 아니라 평가 지표·프로토콜 제안이며, 실증 검증은 기존 공개 대화 데이터셋(DailyDialog, CounselChat, Role-Play, ABC-Eval)과 저자들이 Cesura.ai 플랫폼에서 만든 사례 연구 2건(Sarah 49턴, Evelyn 16건)에 지표를 적용한 것에 그친다. 새로 공개된 평가 데이터셋·문항·스플릿이 없고, 공식 데이터셋/코드 URL도 PDF에 제시되지 않아(링크로 쓸 https 공식 자원 부재) 인벤토리에 추가할 재사용 벤치마크로 보기 어렵다. 또한 사례 연구는 히브리어 대화를 포함해 한국어/영어 과제 범위와도 맞지 않는다.

screening.paper_title: Deep Persona: A Psychologically Grounded Architecture and Evaluation Framework for Role-Playing Agents and Simulations
screening.abstract: Existing approaches to persona simulation with Large Language Models (LLMs) mostly rely on shallow character descriptions that fail to sustain coherent character behavior across extended interactions. We introduce Deep Persona, a psychologically grounded, three-layered architecture that organizes personas into hierarchical levels of observable expression, latent beliefs, and core motivational drives, for constructing highly convincing role-playing agents. Governed by the principles of scripted determinism and bounded agency, the architecture restricts the model to a reactive engine guided by a structured internal script. We further propose a reference-free evaluation framework that benchmarks dialogue naturalness against empirical human distributions using established psychological clinical instruments and adversarial stress-tests. Empirical evaluation reveals that while LLMs achieve high pragmatic fluency, they exhibit systematic limitations in emotional expression and joint attention. In addition, we present a case study of two Deep Personas and evaluate them using the proposed framework, demonstrating that structured personas can produce interactions that more closely align with human conversational behavior.
